sections.title: Total population in Havant
sections.content: In 2024, Havant was the 39th largest local authority in the South East, with a population of almost 130,000. Since 2001, its population has increased by 8.6%.

sections.title: Population density in Havant
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Havant was 2,278 people per square kilometre, which was more than the South East (506), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Median age in Havant
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Havant was 45 years, which was older than the South East (41 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
